subject.title: [Feature]: bearer token authentication for proxy servers

question: Should this issue remain open for setup-code/Android UI/OIDC completion, or should maintainers declare the merged per-gateway custom-header work sufficient and track any leftovers separately?
rationale: The merged static-header plumbing solves a large part of the deployment problem, but current main still lacks the QR/setup-code contract requested here and appears to lack an Android user-facing header editor, while OIDC is a materially different security flow.

options.title: Keep open for staged static-header completion
options.body: Finish the setup-code/manual mobile path for bearer/basic/fixed/cookie headers and leave OIDC as a separate design item.

options.title: Close as satisfied by merged mobile PRs
options.body: Treat the iOS and Android runtime custom-header work as enough for this issue and open narrower follow-ups for Android UI, QR metadata, or OIDC only if maintainers still want them.

options.title: Expand to full OIDC design
options.body: Keep this issue as the broad transport-auth umbrella and require a native browser-return/OIDC design before more implementation lands.

recommendation.title: Keep open for staged static-header completion
recommendation.body: Finish the setup-code/manual mobile path for bearer/basic/fixed/cookie headers and leave OIDC as a separate design item.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the strongest recent product/security signal for the landed mobile custom-header contract and closed the narrower tracker after both platform PRs landed.
